title: Repository maintenance backlog
purpose: File-based tracking for engineering and automation closure work. This is not the executable task queue; runnable work must still enter automation/task_queue.json through its registered scheduler and CAS lifecycle.

items.title: Complete independent Source Discovery → Assessment live end-to-end validation
acceptance: Run at least two distinct batches with no more than 20 URLs and 10 MB per batch
Verify immutable artifact digests and predecessor linkage
Verify durable cursor advancement and interruption/resume
Verify no automatic source activation or assessment-artifact publication
Verify exact discovery fingerprint backlog is zero or partitioned into a new verified generation
items.next_action: Reconcile production_control.json, program_registry.json, execution_adapters.json and release pins before any independent dispatch; then run two bounded batches with exact predecessor and cursor verification.

items.title: Reconcile three historical FAILED task records without rewriting history
acceptance: Use supported queue CAS/scheduler lifecycle only
Record verified supersession or cancellation disposition for each applicable task
Never relabel an actually failed production run as SUCCEEDED
Preserve event history and ensure no stale active lease remains
items.next_action: Add or use a schema-supported terminal resolution path for FAILED historical tasks, then reconcile using current successful-run evidence.

items.title: Complete file-based maintenance management and fresh Storage Management validation
acceptance: Keep engineering maintenance records in this file, not GitHub Issues
Keep executable work in the registered task queue
Run full Storage Management validation on the latest main revision
Record run ID, tested commit SHA and complete successful job evidence
items.next_action: Continue the remaining blocked maintenance items; this validation and file-based tracking milestone is complete.

items.title: Set shared JSON document-store default shard and file limits to 40 MB
acceptance: New JSON document writes default to a maximum 40 MB file and 40 MB shard target
Existing manifests and shards remain readable and pass integrity checks
Tests assert the shared defaults
items.next_action: Keep monitoring manifests for oversized shards; legacy V2 event-state requires a separate segmented migration.

items.title: Remove oversized generated overlap-audit report from the tracked main tree

current_evidence.classification: generated audit output; runtime regenerates it; no production input consumer

acceptance: Generated report is not retained as a 72 MB tracked source-tree blob
Audit workflow continues to generate and upload the report as a run artifact
Frozen V1 inventory remains unchanged as historical provenance
items.next_action: Verify a fresh production audit still creates and uploads the report artifact.

items.title: Replace the monolithic V2 event-state file with bounded append-only segments and a verified manifest
acceptance: Every persisted event segment is at most 40 MB
Manifest verifies sequence, record count, byte count, hash chain and total event count
Append and recovery use CAS without losing concurrent events
No total data cap; historical events remain replayable
items.next_action: Implement and test segmented event-log storage and a backwards-compatible migration before enabling or changing the V2 state writer.

items.title: Enable owner-authorized automatic uu.conf SHA and derived Release baseline metadata registration

current_evidence.current_behavior: runner-local proposal only; automatic repository metadata writer disabled
current_evidence.user_authorization: user authorized updates to uu.conf Blob SHA, approved baseline SHA and derived Release baseline SHA; uu.conf bytes remain immutable to automation

acceptance: Only explicit baseline metadata paths may be written
Every uu.conf content-changing commit must be attributable to the repository owner or explicitly authorized actor
Metadata commit must not stage or modify modules/uu.conf
Release, workflow-map and resource-write-set pins must remain mutually consistent
Storage Management CI verifies the metadata-only write boundary
items.next_action: Implement a fenced metadata-only writer with owner-commit verification and an exact path allowlist; preserve read-only access to uu.conf.

closure_rule: Do not mark an item complete without its stated evidence. Do not declare the overall automation closed until every item is complete and a fresh production audit, publish, remote verification and uu.conf SHA check all pass.
